questions.questionText: Explain the main causes of World War I.
questions.answerText: Nationalism, imperial competition, the alliance system, militarism and the assassination of Archduke Franz Ferdinand combined to turn a regional crisis into a continental war.

questions.questionText: What was the significance of the Magna Carta?
questions.answerText: Signed in 1215, it limited the power of the English monarch and established that free people had rights the crown could not ignore.

questions.questionText: Why did the Roman Empire split into eastern and western halves?
questions.answerText: The empire had become too large to govern efficiently from one centre. Diocletian's reforms divided administration, and after Theodosius I the two halves passed to separate rulers in 395 CE.

questions.questionText: State Newton's second law of motion.
questions.answerText: The acceleration of an object is directly proportional to the net force acting on it and inversely proportional to its mass: F = ma.

questions.questionText: What is the difference between a mixture and a compound?
questions.answerText: A mixture contains substances that are not chemically joined and can usually be separated by physical means. A compound is formed by a chemical reaction and its elements are present in fixed proportions.
